curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Worshipped by half a billion people as an infant sovereign, what becomes of a ruler when the imperial walls can no longer hold back the outside world?
curatedMovie.description: Bernardo Bertolucci’s historical drama traces Pu Yi, China’s final emperor, raised as a living deity within the Forbidden City before facing abdication, shifting regimes, and external exploitation.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Slow, somber, and emotionally heavy. A demanding biographical epic best experienced in focused solitude.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Spanning decades across an expansive runtime, it delivers a deeply thoughtful, emotionally weighty study of imperial isolation colliding with turbulent modern history.
